Origin and meaning

Hazel is an English name meaning “the hazel tree”.

About the name Hazel

A nature name from the hazel tree that has returned to fashion.

As a gift or a tattoo

Because it means “the hazel tree”, a Hazel calligraphy print makes a thoughtful gift for someone who loves the name or its meaning.
